sample_data.reset_instructions: Click 'Reset & Seed Demo Data' or 'Empty Inventory' in the inventory view to restore or clear the demo medicine inventory.

problem_solving_method: Architected a multi-workspace pharmacy inventory management system using Next.js App Router and Supabase with strict row-level security. Implemented real-time expiry categorization (<0d, <=30d, 31-90d, >90d), capital risk valuation, 28-day weekly interval loss projection, POS invoice generation with safe non-expired stock filtering, and seamless return/recall workflows.

team_members.major_contribution: Scaffolded application architecture, built multi-tenant workspace isolation with Supabase RLS policies, data calculations aligning with test fixtures, and CSV export functionality.
Built POS sell workflow with invoice generation, stock decrementing, safe expiry validation, and 4-week interval expiry loss breakdown calculation engine.
Designed and implemented botanical clay-card UI system, animated Landing page, Top/Bottom navigation, returned stock inventory management, and chart visualizations.

major_design_decisions: Adopted Supabase row-level security (RLS) and multi-tenant workspace architecture to isolate pharmacy branch data safely.
Enforced strict expiry validation in POS/sell screen to prevent accidental sale of expired pharmaceuticals.
Implemented soft-removal return management to retain historical audit trail for supplier credit and recalls.
Created custom botanical clay-card design system using semantic CSS variables for optimal readability and clinical aesthetics.
known_limitations: Barcode hardware scanner integration currently relies on manual batch and text entry.
SMS/Email notifications for near-expiry stock require third-party gateway webhook configuration.
